oracle: a deck's own preventDefault wins over the viewer's paging (A16.2)
what: useDeck no longer yields to defaultPrevented, so a key a trusted deck already took is paged again by the viewer: D moves past the slide its own script chose, and a flat deck that took ArrowDown is scrolled anyway

target.case: A16.2 keys scroll a flat deck and the rail follows; on a stacked trusted deck they go into the deck through its own keys without scrolling it; the deck's own preventDefault wins inside the frame, stacked or flat
